Allahabad University PGAT Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Central University of Allahabad, Prayagraj (U.P.) has released the Result for the PGAT I and PGAT II (B.Ed, LLB, PG & Other Courses) Admission 2026. The online application process for Allahabad University PGAT Online Form 2026 were accepted from 05 May 2026 to 25 May 2026. The Examination was conducted on 11 June 2026 Candidates must check the complete details for Allahabad University PGAT Result 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 May 2026
  • Last Date : 25 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 May 2026
  • Exam Date : June 2026
  • Admit Card : 11 June 2026
  • Result : 27 June 2026

Application Fee

  • For PGAT I Course
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1,000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • For PGAT II Courses
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1,600/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 800/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
